decision: Promising experimental bounded native residual solver, compiled once. Per-state local C compilation does not amortize on this trace. No production solver changes.

selected.scope: First-solution feasibility, one global ALLDIFF covering all variables, integer SUM and LINEAR_SUM; no mixed facts, predicates, objective or general enumeration query.

timing: Sequential shuffled repeated whole solves. Model/state setup, residual extraction, ctypes encoding, native enumeration, fallbacks and final witness propagation included. Imports, compilation, output and independent square validation excluded. Compilation measured separately.
semantics: Native mode0 checks distinctness incrementally and numeric constraints at complete tuples; mode1 checks closed constraints earlier; mode2 also applies static arithmetic bounds without maintaining propagated domains. Incomplete native searches fall back to ordinary CP. Joint UNSAT uses an aggregate failure label, so dom/wdeg updates and search trees can change. First-solution and exhaustive-failure correctness are tested; ordinary DFS-node counts exclude native candidate visits.
experiments: The 10k pilot explores residual limits16/20/24. Three-repeat 50k and200k batches compare limits20/24. A single limit20, 200k policy is confirmed on8/9/13/16, then tested unchanged on11/14.
jitter: 14x14 holdout is effectively flat; times are workload-specific and include Python extraction overhead. No multi-fold whole-solve improvement is claimed.
compilation: Use jit_confirmation for uncontended compilation timings. The first JIT pilot could overlap correctness checks. Jit_final rechecks after adding constant-constraint handling; generated programs for the five captured cases retain the same source hashes.
reuse: All2310 eligible baseline16 residuals are distinct after substituting fixed variables. Domain-length/constraint shapes occur at most9times; ignoring domain lengths gives a maximum11. These trace counts do not establish reuse rates for other problems.
coverage20: In the observed10-second blank20 search, the minimum pre-propagation unresolved count is55: no residual qualifies for the selected limit20. This experiment does not solve20 or establish a speedup there.
provenance: Every stage retains frozen source hashes and source tar. The preliminary replay omitted the entrypoint from its source-hash list; the final replay repeats all75 cases with complete entrypoint provenance and is used for conclusions. Historical stage sources may precede later CLI validation or formatting; snapshots preserve their actual bytes.
